options.name: onCreate
options.doc: Invoked when a new file appears in the watched directory, or in one of its subdirectories when the listener is configured to recurse. Declares no return type; the file module rejects any return clause on this handler.

params.name: fileEvent
params.doc: The absolute file URI in name and the triggering operation, always "create", in operation.

options.name: onModify
options.doc: Invoked when an existing file's contents or attributes change in the watched directory. Declares no return type; the file module rejects any return clause on this handler.

params.name: fileEvent
params.doc: The absolute file URI in name and the triggering operation, always "modify", in operation.

options.name: onDelete
options.doc: Invoked when a file disappears from the watched directory. There is no file content or metadata beyond the event itself, because the file is already gone. Declares no return type; the file module rejects any return clause on this handler.

params.name: fileEvent
params.doc: The absolute file URI in name and the triggering operation, always "delete", in operation.

rules.message: A Local Files service must declare at least one of onCreate, onModify, or onDelete, otherwise no event is ever dispatched. This connector has no onError handler to mistake for one.
